# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge is not a suggestion—it's a battle cry. Notice the order: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Strength is the last word, not the first, because biblical strength is built on vigilance and faith. Too many of us chase the gym version of manhood while neglecting the spiritual watchtower. We want the muscle without the vigilance, the victory without the war. But courage isn't the absence of fear—it's obedience in the presence of it. Every morning you wake up, you're stepping onto a battlefield whether you feel like it or not. Your family needs a man who stands firm. Your church needs a man who acts with conviction. Your own soul needs a man who refuses to drift. That strength doesn't show up by accident. It's forged in prayer before dawn, in Scripture before the noise, in discipline before the temptation. So today, don't wait to feel strong. Stand firm first—strength follows obedience.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep thank God for the strength He's already given you. Then spend five minutes in prayer before you touch your phone.
